records.notes: Confirmed keel-cooled, dry-stack, naturally aspirated installation. Raw-water-pump/heat-exchanger service items from the generic LP668 manual are intentionally omitted because the manual states the raw-water pump applies to heat-exchanger-cooled engines.

records.name: Generator

records.name: Wing Engine
records.notes: Confirmed get-home engine. Installed fall 2017. Exact marine gear model and oil capacity are not entered because the installed gear/configuration has not been verified. Yanmar 3YM30AE break-in guidance (YM Series Operation Manual, 2025.02): from 10 to 50 operating hours, use the engine over its full operating range with emphasis on relatively high power settings; Yanmar says maximum speed minus 400 rpm (~70% load) most of the time, 10 minutes at maximum minus 200 rpm (~80% load) every 30 minutes, and 4–5 minutes at WOT once each 30 minutes. Avoid low-speed/light-load operation for more than 30 minutes; if unavoidable, race the engine afterward. Complete the initial 50-hour maintenance at 50 hours.

records.name: Stabilizer System
records.notes: Confirmed Naiad 174-1 system. The verified 162-254 owner handbook gives 3 years or 4000 operating hours for reservoir oil and lower seals. No stabilizer hour meter is entered because no such meter on Trickster has been verified, so this dataset tracks the calendar side and calls out the omitted 4000-hour trigger in the task notes.
